responsibility: Implements character and string text I/O over IOChan channels. It flushes pending output before reads, uses TextUtil helpers and IOChan look/skip primitives to perform line-bounded character, string, token, and skip-line input while maintaining correct NUL termination and ReadResults states such as endOfLine, endOfInput, and outOfRange, and emits characters, strings, and line marks through IOChan text-write hooks for the output side.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file provides the working TextIO algorithms: unlike the same-stem .def declaration file, it implements reads and writes over IOChan, uses TextUtil helpers, flushes pending output before input, and sets concrete end-of-line/end-of-input and range results.
